title: E0116: Remote command execution via popen
plain_english: Passing untrusted input to `popen()` can allow an attacker to execute arbitrary shell commands on the server.
why_matters: Command injection through `popen()` can: - Run arbitrary system commands - Read or modify files and databases - Install malware or backdoors - Lead to full server compromise
what_it_checks: `popen()` calls where the command string contains tainted input from superglobals
`popen()` calls with user-controlled command arguments without `escapeshellcmd()` or `escapeshellarg()`
